title: Custom Skirmish Trails: mission file (format 1)
description: One mission of a trail, the same data as one line of the trail csv file. Export / Import and trail_missions convert between both.

$schema.description: Optional schema path or URL for editor validation and hover help.

format.description: Required mission file format number, currently 1.

map_name.description: Required map filename for the mission, with or without .map; scenario maps use a bare Latin-1 filename of at most 200 bytes.

mission_name.description: Mission title in the briefing, blank if omitted and replaceable by a language file.

mission_kind.description: Use skirmish (the default) for a trail battle or scenario to play the map with its own players, goals and events.

keep_start_army.description: Use 1 to keep the full starting army on scenario start and restart, or 0 or omission to keep the normal scenario rules.

unit_limit.description: Player troop cap, capped by the game's skirmish limit. Use native (the default), formula BASE OFFSET (BASE divided by living lords minus OFFSET), or by_alive LORDS=LIMIT pairs such as by_alive 8=250 1=2000.

scenario_briefing.description: Scenario missions only: the game's briefing text for this mission, shown instead of the map's own description, at most 999 bytes. A language file can give its own; omit to keep the map's text.

text_description.description: Up to eight briefing lines in order, with missing lines left blank.

advantage.description: Starting advantage from human_large through human_small, neutral and ai_small to ai_large (1-5 in that order); omission supplies no advantage override.

start_mode.description: Starting conditions for normal, crusader or deathmatch (1-3 in that order); omission supplies no start mode override.

players.description: Required list of one to eight players, with the human first and AI opponents or allies after them.

items.description: players[0]: the human player (player 1). Has no "ai".

lord.description: Use Arab or Europ for the player's lord and starting troops, or omit to keep the player's choice.

skip_start_units.description: Use 1 to start with only the lord, or 0 or omission to keep the starting troops.

name.description: Name shown in the briefing and game, with the usual player or AI name used if omitted or empty.

start_position.description: Map starting position number as a non-negative integer, left unset if omitted.

team.description: Team number as a non-negative integer, with matching team numbers grouping players; omit to leave it unset.

aiv_type.description: AI castle layout index as a non-negative integer, left unset if omitted.

gold.description: This player's start gold; 0 is no gold. Left out: the game's start gold for the advantage and start mode.

ai.description: Required AI key such as SK_RAT or its alias from ai_character_mapping.

name.description: Name shown in the briefing and game, with the usual player or AI name used if omitted or empty.

start_position.description: Map starting position number as a non-negative integer, left unset if omitted.

team.description: Team number as a non-negative integer, with matching team numbers grouping players; omit to leave it unset.

aiv_type.description: AI castle layout index as a non-negative integer, left unset if omitted.

gold.description: This player's start gold; 0 is no gold. Left out: the game's start gold for the advantage and start mode.

color.description: AI player slot as orange, yellow, blue, black, purple, lightblue or green (2-8 in that order); omission uses its own slot or the first free one.

producible.description: Weapon production switches keyed by CSV suffix (for example bows), where 1 enables and 0 disables; omitted entries keep the game's rules.

recruitable.description: Recruitment switches keyed by CSV suffix (for example archers), where 1 enables and 0 disables; omitted entries keep the game's rules.

resources.description: Starting stock keyed by CSV suffix (for example wood), with counts as integers or numeric text; omitted entries keep the game's starting stock.

tradeable.description: Market trading switches keyed by CSV suffix (for example wood), where 1 enables and 0 disables; omitted entries keep the game's rules.

marker.description: Door pictures of the mission from trail_marker_sheet, one per state and each optional; a state without a picture shows the game's own marker. A mission off the trail's order (a side mission, a parallel path) needs its available picture.

locked.description: Picture index (0-129) while the mission can't be clicked yet. Leave it out to draw nothing until it opens.

available.description: Picture index (0-129) while the mission can be clicked. Leave it out to show the game's marker of the next mission. With it, the door also stays locked until its date and its map.

won.description: Picture index (0-129) drawn over the available picture after a win (not after a chicken). Leave it out to show the game's flag.

extra.description: Additional CSV columns as text, with conflicting values overriding structured fields; omit if you have none.
